### Learning to Listen to God
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/learning-to-listen-to-god
Passage: Psalm 81:8-16
Points:
- Listening to God is just as essential as speaking to Him, though believers often neglect quiet attentiveness.
- Deepening a genuine relationship with the Lord requires regular two-way conversation rather than one-way petitions.
- Grounding oneself in Scripture builds spiritual discernment to accurately distinguish God's voice from deception.
- Ignoring God's guidance amounts to rejecting Him and causes believers to forfeit His intended blessings.
- God remains ready to speak and provide bountifully to those who humble themselves and respond with obedience.

### Devotional: Psalms 81-82
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deuteronomy-1-psalms-81-82-isaiah-29-3-john/
Passage: Psalm 81:10
Points:
- God's invitation to open wide our mouths reveals His full willingness to satisfy our deepest longings.
- Human tragedy stems from refusing to receive the abundant spiritual food and help God offers.
- God's historic deliverance of His people from distress establishes His right to demand undivided worship.
- Persistent stubbornness toward God's voice leads to the judgment of being abandoned to our own devices.
- Earthly gifts and routine pleasures frequently become insidious idols that dull our appetite for God Himself.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 6/30
Author: Barbour Publishing
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-6-or-30-552418.html
Passage: Psalm 81:2
Points:
- Lifting songs of praise lifts the heavy pressures of the world from the believer's heart.
- Musical worship serves as a powerful medium through which God's presence becomes palpable and real.
- God designed music as a universal language that unifies people and draws them nearer to Himself.
- Sincere devotion and heart intent are far more important to God than polished artistic ability.
